targets.expr: sum by(instance, device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) + ignoring(pod) group_right() (label_replace(count by(instance, pod, device) (container_fs_writes_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container="querier", device!~".*sda.*"}), "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)") * 0)

sum by(instance,device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) + ignoring(pod) group_right() (label_replace(count by(instance, pod, device) (container_fs_writes_bytes_total{app_instance=~"$app_instance", namespace=~"$namespace", container="querier", device!~".*sda.*"}), "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)") * 0)

sum by(instance, device) (rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) + ignoring(pod) group_right() (label_replace(count by(instance, pod, device) (container_fs_writes_bytes_total{app_instance=~"$app_instance", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"loki|index-gateway", pod=~"(.*index-gateway.*|loki)", device!~".*sda.*"}), "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)") * 0)

sum by(instance, device) (rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total[$__rate_interval])) + ignoring(pod) group_right() (label_replace(count by(instance, pod, device) (container_fs_writes_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace", container="index-gateway", pod=~"(.*index-gateway.*)", device!~".*sda.*"}), "device", "$1", "device", "/dev/(.*)") * 0)

sum by(pod) (loki_prometheus_rule_group_rules{app_instance=~"$app_instance", job=~"($namespace)/.*-ruler"}) or sum by(pod) (cortex_prometheus_rule_group_rules{app_instance=~"$app_instance", job=~"($namespace)/.*-ruler"})
